nativeValidation.method: loadGoalBookBuildInputs rebuilt the current Math atlas in memory; buildGoalDescriptionRolloutSubsetModel reconstructed the original B045 twenty-goal package shape in memory solely to compare these seven pages. buildGoalDescriptionCanonicalContext compared the current goal context. validateGoalDescriptionReviewCampaignResultDirectories validated both historical sealed campaigns against their original artifacts. No publication or campaign artifacts were written.
nativeValidation.limitations: Exact equality is established for the seven reconstructed page objects, canonical V3 goal contexts, bilingual texts and active image bytes. This does not reconstruct an unrecorded historical official-source snapshot or independently approve every nationwide mapping. Actual public JPGs were opened and inspected individually; no OCR-only image judgment was used. The two historical reviews are preserved as the original sealed runs, not recast as newly independent reviews.

reviewReusePolicy.unchangedCurrentMaterial: The original independent records are reusable as current evidence of the existing holds and as individualized understanding/performance/transfer authoring input. Six pairs are BLOCK/BLOCK; the remaining pair is BLOCK/KEEP. None meets strict closure, and an additional blind review of unchanged faulty material would not repair the observed defect.
reviewReusePolicy.afterSubstantiveImageCorrection: Preserve every old record and dissent. Review the corrected image as an image, rebuild the affected page and input bindings, then obtain two independent current description reviews for a possible strict closure. The old page-bound records cannot silently become reviews of new image bytes. Their content-specific reasoning can guide separate P-profile authoring, with independently presented performance and changed-case transfer retained.
reviewReusePolicy.scope: No registry, in-flight ledger, P ledger, runtime contract, canonical goal, existing source asset or public asset was changed. Existing good illustrations elsewhere remain outside this receipt. Corrections below are concrete candidate work, not generated assets or approvals.

The small identically labeled graph icon places its minimum to the right of the y-axis. Replace only the misleading shorthand by the correct chain rule, for example d/dx F(u(x))=F'(u(x))*u'(x).
